name: Lords Ishwar Hotels Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1985, Lords Ishwar Hotels Ltd 
 is in the business of Hotels and Restaurants[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
LIHL is an ISO 9001:2008 certified, eco-friendly, three-star hotel located in Vadodara, operating under the name Revival Lords Inn. Approved by the Government of India's Department of Tourism, the centrally air-conditioned hotel features 54 well-furnished rooms, a multi-cuisine restaurant named Blue Coriander, a health club, 3 banquet/conference halls, and various international and recreational facilities.
